label: Finite interpretations for the eight root-wiring derivations: for the premise that carries each…
description: Finite interpretations for the eight root-wiring derivations: for the carrying premise of each (the owner-approved concreteness commitment twice, each rival refutation, the performed doubt and the retorsion), a hand-written model on Unit or Bool in which the other non-logical premises hold and the conclusion fails (nine omission models), and one joint nonvacuity witness with populated antecedents. Excluded middle is not omitted (no finite countermodel in a classical metatheory). Satisfiability and omission only; no model is claimed to describe reality.
